reason: The source diff caches the decision path in the base search strategy and replaces repeated model/solver traversal in the basic IntStrategy decision loop. It also changes strategy-scope lookups and fixes ConflictOrderingSearch monitor registration; those components must be reported as inactive when evaluating a basic search strategy.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Caching DecisionPath may reduce work per branching decision on CP instances with many search nodes. Added BitSet construction may offset that gain; the search tree and exact proof time must be measured end to end.
causal_chain: The pre-PR IntStrategy resolves variable, model, solver, and decision path for each decision. The PR reads a DecisionPath cached when AbstractStrategy is created. Basic search does not call the changed conflict monitor or scope-membership branches, so any observed effect on this panel is limited to decision construction and shared initialization.
structural_trigger: Bin-packing and graph-coloring CP instances with many IntStrategy decisions under input-order or activity-based search; a low-node instance is a control for setup cost.
activation_probe: Count IntStrategy and ActivityBased decision calls, their decision-path access on both builds, total nodes and contradictions, and the inactive conflict-monitor and scope-query paths.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze CP bin-packing and graph-coloring cases by variable count, branching count on visible development instances, and difficulty before hidden scoring; include low-node controls and retain all selected cases and timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Run the shared Choco exact solver driver on original CP instances with its basic input-order and activity-based strategies. Use paired instrumentation to prove repeated decision creation and explicitly report the conflict-strategy changes as inactive. Independently check original-instance solutions and proof claims.
mathematical_risk: A wrong variable-ID scope map or monitor lifecycle can skip a legitimate branching decision, affect completeness, or cause an incorrect optimality claim; additional BitSet allocations may increase memory.
independent_check_plan: Verify returned assignments against original bin-packing or coloring constraints and objective values; compare optimal and infeasible claims with trusted optima or an independent solver on tractable cases; run targeted monitor-lifecycle and scope-completeness regressions.
hidden_generalization_plan: Use paired hidden CP instances from both problem families, grouped by size and difficulty; report verified solves, proof time, timeout objective/gap where valid, and regressions by family, including low-node controls.
overlap_review: The PR bundles scope representation, decision-path caching, and a monitor correctness fix. It must count as one historical PR, and later overlapping Choco strategy PRs need lineage review before a separate task is admitted.
resource_risk: One BitSet is allocated per strategy, and variable IDs can make it larger than the strategy scope. Extra monitor activity may add overhead despite faster membership tests.
